request.query: Roth's theorem finite rational approximations algebraic irrational exponent greater than two

items.name: Liouville.exists_pos_real_of_irrational_root
items.type:
∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ∀ {f : Polynomial ℤ},
      f ≠ 0 →
        Polynomial.eval α (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℝ) f) = 0 →
          ∃ A, 0 < A ∧ ∀ (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ), 1 ≤ (↑b + 1) ^ f.natDegree * (|α - ↑a / (↑b + 1)| * A)

items.name: LiouvilleWith.irrational
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ}, LiouvilleWith p x → 1 < p → Irrational x

items.name: setOf_liouvilleWith_subset_aux
items.type:
{x | ∃ p > 2, LiouvilleWith p x} ⊆
  ⋃ m,
    (fun x => x + ↑m) ⁻¹'
      ⋃ n, ⋃ (_ : n > 0), {x | ∃ᶠ (b : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ a ∈ Finset.Icc 0 ↑b, |x - ↑a / ↑b| < 1 / ↑b ^ (2 + 1 / ↑n)}

items.name: Rat.den_le_and_le_num_le_of_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq
items.type: ∀ {ξ q : ℚ}, |ξ - q| < 1 / ↑q.den ^ 2 → q.den ≤ ξ.den ∧ ⌈ξ * ↑q.den⌉ - 1 ≤ q.num ∧ q.num ≤ ⌊ξ * ↑q.den⌋ + 1

items.name: setOf_liouville_eq_irrational_inter_iInter_iUnion
items.type: {x | Liouville x} = {x | Irrational x} ∩ ⋂ n, ⋃ a, ⋃ b, ⋃ (_ : 1 < b), Metric.ball (↑a / ↑b) (1 / ↑b ^ n)

items.name: LiouvilleWith.frequently_lt_rpow_neg
items.type: ∀ {p q x : ℝ}, LiouvilleWith p x → q < p → ∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ m, x ≠ ↑m / ↑n ∧ |x - ↑m / ↑n| < ↑n ^ (-q)

items.name: Behrend.bound_aux
items.type: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, d ≠ 0 → 2 ≤ n → ↑d ^ (n - 2) / ↑n ≤ ↑(rothNumberNat ((2 * d - 1) ^ n))
